title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list.
Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com.
Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

We need a Digital Advertising Strategist to help transform our digital advertising team into a data-driven performance machine. We want our team members to be proactive and persistent until they are able to turn data into profitable insights for our customers and partners alike. We are looking for someone with extremely high standards who is efficient and not afraid to roll up their sleeves and do what it takes to help our partners be successful. If you are intelligent, organized, and a high-energy builder, we encourage you to apply. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule (three days in office, two days remote per week) based in Lehi, Utah.

What is a day in the life of a Digital Advertising Strategist?

  • Manage and delegate the creation of PPC and display campaigns across Amazon, Walmart, Google, Facebook, etc.
  • Perform market research to build tailored and relevant full-funnel strategies for clients
  • Nurture partner relationships by meeting regularly to review performance, negotiate advertising budgets, and discuss strategy ideas
  • Research and test effective keywords, bidding strategies, and ad copy to catalyze traffic and sales velocity
  • Collaborate with the brand management team to align advertising goals with the internal ambitions set by our partners

What will I need to thrive in this role?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related program
  • 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in paid search and display advertising (Google Ads, Facebook, etc.)
  • Demonstrable Excel knowledge, data analysis, and problem solving skills
  • Prior experience in managing client relationships and communicating with key internal & external partners
  • Demonstrable quickness in learning new things and an ambitious attitude

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Working history with the Amazon advertising platform and third party tools like Helium 10, Pacvue, Viral Launch, etc.
  • Knowledge of advanced auto-bid tools, such as Marin or DS3
  • Skills in web analytics and relevant attribution models
  • Experience in retail revenue strategy

What does high performance look like?

  • You are agile and experimental, bringing new ideas and moving fast to achieve goals
  • You are self-driven, organized, and proactive mindset with high ethical standards
  • You love web analytics, attribution models, and are up to speed on all the latest trends
  • You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner
  • You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given
  • You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion

What is my potential for career growth?

  • You will learn valuable skills in Amazon Ads, leadership, and marketplace strategy as well as build relationships with department leaders at Pattern and brand executives. These skills and relationships can lead to career advancement within the company. We are passionate about developing our amazing talent and providing excellent opportunities for career growth within Pattern.

What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days?

  • 30 Days - you have your team schedule and structure established with regular 1:1s, you build strong relationships with team members, brand managers, and brand partners
  • 60 Days - you hold regular strategy sessions to share valuable suggestions with brand partners
  • 90 Days - you build and execute successful ad strategies and understand the nuances of your brands’ advertising needs

What is the team like?

  • You will work with the other Associate Directors and Ad Strategists and be supervised by the Director of Digital Advertising. You will also be mentored by the VP of Advertising and meet with them on a regular basis to discuss your performance. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.

We want individuals who are:

  • Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
  • Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
  • Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
  • Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

  • Initial phone interview with Pattern’s talent acquisition team
  • Video interview with a hiring manager
  • Onsite interview with a panel of department leaders
  • Professional reference checks
  • Executive review
  • Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

  • Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples
  • Be ready to talk about how you can add value and be the best addition to the team
  • Focus on mentioning how you would make a difference at Pattern
  • Be prepared to talk about any side projects related to data and analytics
Why should I work at Pattern?
Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid Holidays
  • Onsite Fitness Center
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Casual Dress Code
  • Competitive Pay
  • Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance
  • 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred.
Pattern provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Marketing Graphic Specialist
description:
Join our team in a highly creative, collaborative studio culture

MSR Design is a studio of highly motivated individuals fueled by curiosity and a passion for learning. Our staff members come from a variety of backgrounds and thrive in an integrated studio culture.


Marketing Graphic Specialist

MSR Design is looking for a design-minded, highly organized, and driven marketing graphic specialist with at least three years of relevant professional experience to help us tell compelling, authentic stories about our work and succeed in winning new projects that align with our goals.

This role sits at the intersection of design, storytelling, marketing, and business development. We are looking for someone with a strong visual eye who understands the unique qualities of a project, team, or approach and can translate that understanding into persuasive proposals, presentations, graphics, and other marketing materials.

Candidates with a background in marketing or communications or with a background in architecture, interior design, or other design disciplines with strong graphic communication skills and an interest in marketing and business development are encouraged to apply.



Qualifications of Ideal Candidate

  • A strong eye for graphic design, composition, typography, imagery, and visual storytelling.
  • The ability to understand a project, client, or pursuit strategy; shape ideas into a clear, compelling, authentic story; select applicable project imagery; and develop supporting graphics and diagrams.
  • Genuine interest in architecture, design, marketing, and business development.
  • Curiosity, drive, initiative, creativity, attention to detail, and a commitment to producing high-quality work and meeting deadlines.
  • A willingness to ask questions, seek context, and dig deeper to understand the core essence of a project, pursuit, or story.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines at once, anticipate what is needed, and confidently keep efforts moving forward by following up with business development leaders, the marketing manager, and project leaders for content and decisions.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced, highly creative environment.
  • A desire to continually improve the quality of the work and how it gets done.


Job Responsibilities

  • Developing and producing proposals in response to RFPs and preparing presentation materials for new business pursuits.
  • Working with business development leaders and the marketing manager to understand pursuit strategies and potential client priorities and helping to shape the content that will position us to win work that meets our strategic goals.
  • Selecting project images, precedents, and other content and developing graphics, diagrams, and layouts to convey our message.
  • Managing multiple proposal schedules and tight deadlines simultaneously and proactively following up with contributors to keep work progressing forward.
  • Leading the firm’s awards submission program.
  • Managing the firm’s digital asset management system that houses our image library.
  • Maintaining the company website and creating and sharing social media content.
  • Coordinating project photography shoots.
  • Maintaining MSR Design’s visual identity and graphic standards across print and digital materials.
  • Assisting with CRM and marketing database maintenance and reporting.


Strong proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator, is required. Experience with Microsoft 365 programs and digital asset management, CRM, CMS, social media, and AI-enabled marketing tools are preferred.

Experience working in an architecture, interior design, or related design environment is highly valued. A bachelor’s degree in graphic design, architecture, interior design, marketing, communications, or a related field is preferred.



Salary range: $70,000–$85,000


MSR Design is a WBE-certified architecture and interior design firm committed to designing a better future. We offer competitive salary and benefits.


MSR Design is an affirmative action, equal opportunity employer with a Just label.


How to Apply
To apply for this position, submit a cover letter, resume, and digital portfolio to: officemanager@msrdesign.com

title: Influencer Marketing Manager
description:
Role: Influencer Marketing Manager

Team: Brand, Marketing

Location: Remote or hybrid on-site at the Studio McGee | McGee & Co. HQ in Draper, UT

Employment Type: Full-Time


Overview:

Studio McGee is looking for an Influencer Marketing Manager to lead the day-to-day strategy and execution of our influencer and creator marketing program.

This role will help evolve our influencer program beyond gifting and traditional affiliate relationships into a more intentional mix of organic relationships, paid creator partnerships, affiliate commerce, and high-performing creator content that can be amplified across the broader marketing ecosystem.

The Influencer Marketing Manager will identify and cultivate creators who authentically represent the Studio McGee brand, develop partnerships that introduce new customers to Studio McGee and drive product discovery, and build a pipeline of compelling creator content that can be leveraged across paid media, email, social, PDPs, and other owned channels.

The ideal candidate has strong instincts for brand and design, understands the creator landscape, is highly relationship-oriented, and is equally comfortable evaluating creative quality and analyzing performance.


Who We are:

Founded in 2014, Studio McGee, Inc. is one of the fastest growing home design brands in America. Our journey began with a thriving interiors business that focused on approachable, yet aspirational design. By leveraging the power of digital communities, we were able to expand our footprint in the interior design industry through an unconventional approach that connected us with our consumers. We continued to carry that forward-thinking attitude into the launch of our retail business, McGee & Co., which anchors the operational and revenue growth of our company. Our licensing partnerships allow us to further expand our design voice beyond our own collection. From a multi-year partnership with Target to an Emmy-nominated Netflix Series and a NY Times Best-Selling book, Studio McGee's passion is to empower people to design with an approachability that enhances their daily life and elevates their every day. Whether following us on social media or becoming part of our company, we invite you to join us on our mission to “Make Life Beautiful.”


What You'll Do:


Influencer Strategy & Partnerships

  • Execute Studio McGee's influencer and creator strategy across organic, gifting, affiliate, and paid partnerships.
  • Identify and develop relationships with creators who authentically represent Studio McGee's aesthetic, values, and customer.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of creators across different audience sizes, categories, and markets.
  • Develop paid creator partnerships with clear objectives, deliverables, timelines, compensation structures, and performance expectations.
  • Manage creator relationships from initial outreach and negotiation through content delivery, reporting, and ongoing relationship management.
  • Partner with the Director of Brand and CMO to continually refine where and how Studio McGee invests in influencer marketing.


Creator Commerce & Affiliate

  • Manage creator relationships and programs across platforms including ShopMy, LTK, and AWIN.
  • Use affiliate and commerce data to identify creators with strong brand alignment and demonstrated ability to influence purchasing behavior.
  • Partner with internal teams to identify priority products and categories for creator campaigns, with an emphasis on key growth categories such as furniture, lighting, rugs, bedding, and seasonal collections.
  • Develop strategies that balance product discovery, new customer acquisition, content creation, and attributable revenue.
  • Continually evaluate creator and campaign performance to determine where to increase, decrease, or redirect investment.


Creator Content & Amplification

  • Build a scalable pipeline of high-quality creator content that extends beyond creators' organic audiences.
  • Secure appropriate content usage rights and whitelisting permissions as part of paid partnerships.
  • Partner with Paid Media, Creative, Social, E-commerce, and Email teams to identify creator content that can be amplified across marketing channels.
  • Help develop and test different applications of creator content, including creator-led advertising, brand voiceovers, product-focused edits, PDP content, and promotional campaigns.
  • Identify high-performing creator content and partnerships that can be scaled or repeated.


Gifting & Relationship Management

  • Oversee Studio McGee's influencer gifting and product-seeding program.
  • Develop thoughtful gifting strategies tied to launches, seasonal priorities, and key product categories rather than relying solely on broad product seeding.
  • Maintain strong, authentic relationships with existing creators while continuously identifying new voices and audiences.
  • Manage creator communications and ensure partners have a consistently high-quality Studio McGee experience.


Retail & Local Influencer Support

  • Build relationships with relevant creators in markets surrounding Studio McGee retail locations and future store openings.
  • Partner with Brand and Retail teams to identify the right creators to support store openings, shopping experiences, product launches, and local activations.
  • Own the influencer component of events and activations, including creator identification, outreach, attendance, deliverables, and follow-up.
  • Partner with the Director of Brand on broader events and community initiatives while remaining focused on influencer and creator participation.


Measurement & Optimization

  • Establish clear objectives and KPIs for influencer campaigns before launch.
  • Track performance across paid partnerships, gifting, affiliate activity, content, and product/category initiatives.
  • Measure both brand and commercial impact, including reach, engagement, content performance, traffic, new customer acquisition, affiliate revenue, ROAS, and product sales where measurable.
  • Partner with Performance Marketing and Analytics teams to understand how creator content performs when amplified through paid media.
  • Develop regular reporting that identifies what's working, what isn't, and where Studio McGee should invest next.
  • Maintain budget discipline and evaluate partnerships based on both performance and strategic brand value.


What You'll Bring:

  • 4–6+ years of experience in influencer, creator, affiliate, social, or related digital marketing roles, preferably within a consumer, lifestyle, home, fashion, beauty, or retail brand.
  • Hands-on experience managing influencer relationships and paid creator partnerships.
  • Experience with creator commerce and affiliate platforms such as ShopMy, LTK, AWIN, or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of influencer contracting, content usage rights, whitelisting, paid amplification, and creator compensation models.
  • Strong understanding of social platforms and the evolving creator landscape.
  • Ability to evaluate both the creative quality of content and its business performance.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using performance data to make investment decisions.
  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and project-management skills.
  • Strong aesthetic judgment and an understanding of what makes content feel authentic to a premium design and lifestyle brand.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple creator relationships, campaigns, product launches, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Collaborative working style and ability to partner effectively across Brand, Creative, Performance Marketing, E-commerce, Merchandising, Retail, PR, and Social.


What Success Looks Like:

Success in this role means Studio McGee has a focused, measurable, and scalable creator program that:

  • Introduces Studio McGee to new and relevant audiences.
  • Builds lasting relationships with creators who authentically represent the brand.
  • Drives meaningful product discovery and customer acquisition.
  • Produces high-quality creator content that performs beyond the creator's own channels.
  • Creates a repeatable pipeline of content for paid media, email, PDPs, social, and other owned channels.
  • Uses performance data to continually improve where and how we invest.
  • Supports Studio McGee's growth as both a premier design and taste leader and a leading home furnishings brand.


Benefits:

  • Remote or hybrid flexibility
  • Competitive compensation + bonuses
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision, hospital indemnity, accident, pet)
  • Open PTO and company paid holidays
  • 401k Employer match - 100% of deferrals up to 4% of compensation
  • Exclusive 50% off Team Member discount at mcgeeandco.com + access to Team Member warehouse sales


McGee is proud to be an equal opportunity employer - we see the beauty of celebrating our teams' differences, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Together we Make Life Beautiful.

  • Develop strategies that balance product discovery, new customer acquisition, content creation, and attributable revenue.
  • Continually evaluate creator and campaign performance to determine where to increase, decrease, or redirect investment.


Creator Content & Amplification

  • Build a scalable pipeline of high-quality creator content that extends beyond creators' organic audiences.
  • Secure appropriate content usage rights and whitelisting permissions as part of paid partnerships.
  • Partner with Paid Media, Creative, Social, E-commerce, and Email teams to identify creator content that can be amplified across marketing channels.
  • Help develop and test different applications of creator content, including creator-led advertising, brand voiceovers, product-focused edits, PDP content, and promotional campaigns.
  • Identify high-performing creator content and partnerships that can be scaled or repeated.


Gifting & Relationship Management

  • Oversee Studio McGee's influencer gifting and product-seeding program.
  • Develop thoughtful gifting strategies tied to launches, seasonal priorities, and key product categories rather than relying solely on broad product seeding.
  • Maintain strong, authentic relationships with existing creators while continuously identifying new voices and audiences.
  • Manage creator communications and ensure partners have a consistently high-quality Studio McGee experience.


Retail & Local Influencer Support

  • Build relationships with relevant creators in markets surrounding Studio McGee retail locations and future store openings.
  • Partner with Brand and Retail teams to identify the right creators to support store openings, shopping experiences, product launches, and local activations.
  • Own the influencer component of events and activations, including creator identification, outreach, attendance, deliverables, and follow-up.
  • Partner with the Director of Brand on broader events and community initiatives while remaining focused on influencer and creator participation.


Measurement & Optimization

  • Establish clear objectives and KPIs for influencer campaigns before launch.
  • Track performance across paid partnerships, gifting, affiliate activity, content, and product/category initiatives.
  • Measure both brand and commercial impact, including reach, engagement, content performance, traffic, new customer acquisition, affiliate revenue, ROAS, and product sales where measurable.
  • Partner with Performance Marketing and Analytics teams to understand how creator content performs when amplified through paid media.
  • Develop regular reporting that identifies what's working, what isn't, and where Studio McGee should invest next.
  • Maintain budget discipline and evaluate partnerships based on both performance and strategic brand value.


What You'll Bring:

  • 4–6+ years of experience in influencer, creator, affiliate, social, or related digital marketing roles, preferably within a consumer, lifestyle, home, fashion, beauty, or retail brand.
  • Hands-on experience managing influencer relationships and paid creator partnerships.
  • Experience with creator commerce and affiliate platforms such as ShopMy, LTK, AWIN, or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of influencer contracting, content usage rights, whitelisting, paid amplification, and creator compensation models.
  • Strong understanding of social platforms and the evolving creator landscape.
  • Ability to evaluate both the creative quality of content and its business performance.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using performance data to make investment decisions.
  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and project-management skills.
  • Strong aesthetic judgment and an understanding of what makes content feel authentic to a premium design and lifestyle brand.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple creator relationships, campaigns, product launches, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Collaborative working style and ability to partner effectively across Brand, Creative, Performance Marketing, E-commerce, Merchandising, Retail, PR, and Social.


What Success Looks Like:

Success in this role means Studio McGee has a focused, measurable, and scalable creator program that:

  • Introduces Studio McGee to new and relevant audiences.
  • Builds lasting relationships with creators who authentically represent the brand.
  • Drives meaningful product discovery and customer acquisition.
  • Produces high-quality creator content that performs beyond the creator's own channels.
  • Creates a repeatable pipeline of content for paid media, email, PDPs, social, and other owned channels.
  • Uses performance data to continually improve where and how we invest.
  • Supports Studio McGee's growth as both a premier design and taste leader and a leading home furnishings brand.

  • Competitive compensation + bonuses
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision, hospital indemnity, accident, pet)
  • Open PTO and company paid holidays
  • 401k Employer match - 100% of deferrals up to 4% of compensation
  • Exclusive 50% off Team Member discount at mcgeeandco.com + access to Team Member warehouse sales

EGNYTE YOUR CAREER. SPARK YOUR PASSION.

Egnyte is a place where we spark opportunities for amazing people. We believe that every role has a great impact, and every Egnyter should be respected. When joining Egnyte, you’re not just landing a new career, you become part of a team of Egnyters that are doers, thinkers, and collaborators who embrace and live by our values:

  • Invested Relationships
  • Fiscal Prudence
  • Candid Conversations


ABOUT EGNYTE

Egnyte is the secure multi-cloud platform for content security and governance that enables organizations to better protect and collaborate on their most valuable content. Established in 2008, Egnyte has democratized cloud content security for more than 22,000 organizations, helping customers improve data security, maintain compliance, prevent and detect ransomware threats, and boost employee productivity on any app, any cloud, anywhere. For more information, visit www.egnyte.com.


The Web Marketing Manager is accountable for what goes on egnyte.com, how it is organized, and how well it performs. This is a hands-on role to manage the day-to-day work of the site and lead the projects that improve it. Success takes a data-driven approach to prioritizing the work that will have the greatest impact, strong collaboration with creative, web development, product marketing, and conversion optimization, and the ability to turn their goals into pages that perform.


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Responsible for egnyte.com — what is on the pages, how they are organized, and how well they perform.
  • Be hands-on. You will be personally responsible for the work and close to the details of every project that touches the site.
  • Manage web projects from start to finish — scope, schedule, reviews, and launch — and keep everyone informed along the way.
  • Work with product marketing, demand generation, sales, field marketing, and communications to turn what they need into pages that work.
  • Take part in design reviews. You do not need to be a designer, but you should be able to judge creativity against business goals and best practices to give clear, useful feedback.
  • Work with web development to ensure what gets built matches what was designed, loads quickly, and is accessible.
  • Partner with our conversion optimization lead on testing — what to test, what the results mean, and what to change as a result.
  • Use analytics to find what is not working on the site, recommend fixes, and see them through.
  • Keep the site accurate and current, and apply SEO and AEO fundamentals to page structure, copy, and metadata.
  • Direct internal designers, agencies and contractors on wireframes and mockups to match business requirements.
  • Report to the Senior Director of Brand Marketing.
  • Work day to day with creative, web development, conversion optimization and analytics, product marketing, demand generation, corporate communications, sales, and field marketing.


YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Seven or more years of web marketing experience, preferably at a B2B technology or software company.
  • A proven track record of making a website perform better — redesign, restructuring, optimzation — and the ability to describe what changed and what it produced.
  • Sound business judgment. You can tell the difference between a request that will move the business and one that will not.
  • Experience running several projects at once and finishing them on time with little supervision.
  • Clear communication with people who do not work on the web, including executives.
  • Working knowledge of a content management system (Drupal is a plus) and an analytics platform such as GA4 or Adobe Analytics.
  • General understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to have a productive conversation with developers.
  • SEO and AEO fundamentals, both technical and editorial.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing and personalization tools.


COMPENSATION:

  • Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across multiple U.S. geographic locations, and pay varies based on defined markets. The standard base pay range for this position across the U.S. is $120k - $140k annually. Pay varies by work location and may also be dependent on job-related skills, knowledge, and/or experience. During the interview and/or hiring process, your recruiter can share more information about the compensation package specific to the role and job location.

  • Competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits
  • Flexible hours and generous time off (RTO, Responsible Time Off) to help support your work-life balance
  • Paid holidays and sick time
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with a generous employer contribution and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
  • Up to 12wks of paid Parental and 10wks Adoption Leave to help you grow your family
  • Modern and collaborative offices located in Draper, UT; Raleigh, NC; Mountain View, CA; Reading, England, and Poznan, Poland
  • Gym, cell phone, and internet reimbursement
  • Free well-being apps such as Spring Health for Guardian are offered, as well access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Breeze is hiring- join us!

Are you a motivated, passionate, self-starter that thrives in fast paced environments and lives to make a direct impact on the bottom line? Does the idea of working with a bunch of creative, fun, Seriously Nice marketers to help build the nation’s newest and nicest low-fare airline get you excited? If you enthusiastically answered “Yes!” to the above, then you might just be the person we’re looking for. The Breeze Marketing Team is in search of a Paid Media Specialist to help develop, optimize, and report on digital marketing campaigns across display, paid search, paid social, and more as we expand to more cities across the U.S. and beyond. The role comes with a lot of room to grow and the opportunity to learn from a team of performance marketing experts. And did we mention the travel benefits?

Here’s what you’ll do

  • Lead the development and implementation of digital advertising programs across paid media channels (social, display, video, search, etc.) while aligning with Marketing team KPIs
  • Support upper-funnel programs (audio, CTV, native, etc.) that build brand awareness and fill the funnel with qualified audiences that convert to bookings
  • Manage paid campaign strategy and budgets for Breeze and Airport Partners
  • Track campaign performance and maintain comprehensive reports to provide clear view of program KPIs
  • Partner with creative team to develop assets that drive brand awareness and fill the funnel with qualified audiences resulting in conversions and bookings
  • Proactively leverage revenue data and industry trends to identify and test new channel, segmentation, and revenue opportunities
  • Strategize and execute testing initiatives in areas such as creative assets, messaging, and targeting tactics to improve performance
  • Assist with email marketing and website optimization when necessary
  • Achieve performance measures and adhere to established standards in conjunction with Breeze Aviation Group Values of Safety, Kindness, Integrity, Ingenuity, and Excellence

Here’s what you need to be successful

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4-year degree in Marketing, Advertising, or related fields
  • 2+ years of digital marketing experience with proven and measurable impact to established goals and KPIs
  • 2+ years paid search/paid social experience (Google Ads/Facebook Ads)
  • 2+ years experience with digital marketing reporting and analytics
  • Interest in new technology, particularly AI and automation, and how it can improve marketing performance.
  • Comfortable with topics such as budgeting, bidding, and testing methodology
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management skills.
  • Strong oral and written communications skills.
  • Self-starter must have a positive attitude and strong desire for success.
  • Complete projects on time with minimal supervision, ability to work varied hours when necessary to meet deadlines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience improving marketing performance in new technology- particularly AI and automation.

Skills/Talents

  • Strong sense of paid media fundamentals
  • Strong sense of analytical and reporting skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel
  • Exemplifies Breeze’s safety culture, values, and mission
  • Ability to work with individuals and teams at all levels in the organization


Physical Demands & Working Conditions

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, handling documents, and operating standard office equipment
  • Occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds
  • Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching within an office environment
  • Clear verbal and written communication, requiring adequate speech, hearing, and vision


Perks of the Job

  • Health, Vision and Dental – Full Time
  • Health Savings Account with Breeze Employee Match
  • 401K with Breeze Employee Match
  • Generous PTO
  • Travel on Breeze and other Airlines too!

description:
Role: Digital Performance Marketing Manager

Level: 4-6 years of experience

Team: Web Operations, Marketing

Reports To: Sr. Director, Web Operations

Location: Remote or Hybrid on-site at the Studio McGee | Mcgee & Co. HQ in Draper, UT

Employment Type: Full-Time


Overview:

The Digital Performance Marketing Manager is a key member of our marketing team responsible for driving results across paid digital channels, affiliate programs, and direct mail — ensuring every marketing dollar delivers strong visibility and performance targets.

You will lead the strategy and oversight of paid media and SEO, guide the work of our external paid media agency, manage investments across channels, and elevate search performance to support growth. In addition to paid digital, this role owns our affiliates program (excluding ShopMy and LTK) and maintains visibility into catalog and retargeting direct mail programs — creating a unified view of all paid media investments and enabling a cohesive, cross-channel approach. You will also help establish scalable processes that strengthen the marketing organization and enable future expansion.

This role requires an analytical and strategic marketer with deep expertise in Google Ads, paid social, SEO best practices, and SEM strategy along with a proven ability to deliver clear return on investment.


Who We are:

Founded in 2014, Studio McGee, Inc. is one of the fastest growing home design brands in America. Our journey began with a thriving interiors business that focused on approachable, yet aspirational design. By leveraging the power of digital communities, we were able to expand our footprint in the interior design industry through an unconventional approach that connected us with our consumers.   • Acts like an owner: Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation + bonuses
  • Comprehensive heath benefits (medical, dental, vision, hospital indemnity, accident, pet)
  • Open PTO and paid company holidays
  • 401k Employer match - 100% of deferrals up to 4% of compensation
  • Exclusive 50% off Team Member discount at mcgeeandco.com + access to Team Member warehouse sales
  • Collaborative, creative culture with room to grow

title: Email & Social Media Specialist
description:
Hammerton is a leading American designer/manufacturer of custom decorative lighting for the hospitality, commercial and residential markets. We are known as a major design innovator in our industry, and we’re rapidly growing. Our in-house blown and kiln-fired glass capabilities, combined with our expertise in metal fabrication and machining, make us uniquely capable of addressing the needs of the design industry’s most discerning clients. Hammerton lighting can be found in leading five-star hotels and resorts, award-winning restaurants and many of the most beautiful homes in North America.

The Email & Social Media Specialist is responsible for bringing the Hammerton brand to life across social media (primarily Meta), email, and our blog, from concept and capture through publishing, performance analysis, and optimization. This role reports to the Director of Marketing and supports all Hammerton brands.

This is a hands-on creative role with a strategic, AI-forward mindset. Beyond producing beautiful content, the ideal candidate will design and manage AI agents and automated workflows that multiply the team's output, freeing time for the big-picture thinking that grows our audience and drives results. Success depends on pairing a strong visual eye with analytical rigor and a genuine curiosity about how AI can change the way marketing gets done.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Plan, shoot, and edit story-driven social media photos and videos for Meta and other platforms. Produce short-form video, primarily on a smartphone and use AI post-production tools to showcase our products, artisans, glassblowing and fabrication processes, and installed projects.
  • Own the social media content calendar, including publishing, captions, hashtags, and engagement with our community of designers, architects, and customers.
  • Develop, write, build, and send email campaigns, including newsletters, product launches, and automated nurture sequences for trade and consumer audiences.
  • Manage email list health, segmentation, and testing to improve open, click, and conversion rates.
  • Plan and write blog content that supports brand storytelling, SEO/AEO, and product education.
  • Design, build, and maintain AI agents and automated workflows that support content ideation, drafting, editing, scheduling, reporting, and other repeatable marketing tasks.
  • Evaluate new AI tools and recommend practical ways to improve quality, speed, and efficiency across the marketing team.
  • Track, analyze, and report on social, email, and blog performance, translating data into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Develop quarterly channel strategies aligned with company goals, product launches, and sales priorities.
  • Maintain a consistent, elevated brand voice and visual standard across all channels.
  • Collaborate with Design, Product, Sales, and Production teams to source stories, content, and on-site shoot opportunities.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

Candidates may qualify through a variety of education and experience backgrounds, including:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in social media, content creation, and email marketing with a strong portfolio of results. A bachelor's degree in marketing or another related field is preferred but not required.
  • A portfolio of short-form video content you have shot and edited is required.
  • Experience building or managing AI agents, automations, or AI-assisted workflows is strongly preferred. Please be prepared to share examples.
  • Experience with Klaviyo or other leading email platform software is preferred.
  • Experience marketing luxury, design, home, or hospitality products is preferred.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong visual eye for composition, lighting, and pacing in short-form video.
  • Proficiency shooting and editing short-form video on mobile, using apps such as Canva, Instagram's native editor, or similar.
  • Excellent writing skills with the ability to adapt tone for trade and consumer audiences.
  • Working knowledge of AI tools and platforms, including prompt design, agent configuration, and workflow automation is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using platform analytics, Google Analytics, or similar tools to measure performance and guide decisions.
  • Big-picture strategic thinking balanced with attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced, growing company.
  • Self-motivated, curious, and eager to experiment, learn, and share what works.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across departments.
  • Experience working with Meta and Instagram.
  • Experience with TikTok and Pinterest is preferred.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • On-site position based at our Salt Lake City facility.
  • Regular work on the production floor and in the glass studio to capture content, including adherence to all safety protocols and PPE requirements.
  • Occasional travel to capture installed projects or attend industry events may be required.
